story.title: Our Story
story.intro: Juan Muzzi, a Uruguayan plastic artist based in Brazil for over 40 years, dedicated 12 years of his life to proving that post-consumer plastic could be the foundation for indestructible urban mobility.
story.quote: We're not just making bicycles, we're cleaning the planet and offering eternal freedom.

bones.title: The Mystery of Hollow Bones
bones.p1: One of life's mysteries determined that bones should be hollow. In advanced studies, man discovers that if it weren't so, the heart would have to work harder and much more. Furthermore, body weight would increase by 20%, and limbs would bend easily.
bones.p2: These are internal cavities that form a more harmonic assembly regarding the compression, flexion, and traction required in this system. Hollow bones in skeleton formation allowed humans and vertebrate animals a longer life, offering greater agility, balance, and lightness even for flying, and mechanical resistance far above what one would imagine for a solid bone.
bones.quote: The sophistication of the structural mechanism in the skeleton allowed us to think of a bone structure used in a bicycle frame. Something that could offer lightness and agility, as well as safety to the entire body of the project.
bones.p3: With this reasoning, the internal parts of the frame were created, with volume variations in several locations, which brought more balance and harmony to the frame's structural behavior. Just like airplane wings, where wind exerts a flexion cushioning the impact on the main structure, the same principle was used in the bicycle frame.
bones.p4: The structure flexes to a certain point while riding, making the frame soft and cushioning impacts on the cyclist. For this to happen, a mold for gas-assisted (nitrogen) plastic injection up to 30% of the product's volume is necessary. The skeleton frame weighs 30% less than the solid frame and considerably increases its resistance.

schumpeter.title: The Mirage of Innovation
schumpeter.desc: Economist Joseph Schumpeter stated that an entrepreneur is not just someone who sets up any business, but someone who creates a truly innovative product or process that causes a rupture with the existing pattern.

nature.jung_quote: To this day, humanity's great problems have never been solved by collective decrees, but only by the renewal of the individual's attitude. At no time was meditating on oneself such an imperious necessity.
nature.title: Nature Outperforms Humanity
nature.p1: Natural overcoming is daily, constant, and silent. We have much to learn from nature's 4,000 million years of continuous activity, which provides us with superior models for a more sustainable society.
nature.p2: The disposal of plastic materials and the production of aluminum are environmentally incorrect processes on a large scale. Therefore, we developed a contemporary industrial process that produces a frame with a lifetime warranty, based on the principle of photosynthesis.

pdl.title: Clean Development Process (PDL)
pdl.item1_desc: We take biomass and discarded plastic waste to inject frames without mineral extraction.
pdl.item2_desc: We drastically reduce the greenhouse effect and energy consumption compared to traditional aluminum methods.
pdl.final_quote: This PDL gives us the characteristics for a new concept of mobility, gathering art, philosophy, technology, and subtleties, such as solidarity and ecologically correct action.

sustainability.title: Eco-efficiency in Every Detail
sustainability.desc: Our PDL process transforms what would be waste into structure. We reduce energy consumption by 90% compared to aluminum or steel frames, creating a new standard for the industry.

doctrine.title: Our Doctrine
doctrine.manifesto: A Muzzicycles is not just a bicycle. It's a manifesto. Designed to outlast you, our structure challenges planned obsolescence and transforms waste into freedom.

items.a: It is the world's first bicycle frame manufactured by injection of recycled polymers (post-consumer plastic), without welds and with a lifetime warranty.
The frame is designed to last a long time. The material does not suffer fatigue like metal and is immune to oxidation.
Yes, all our models have European Community (CE) certification, ensuring the highest international safety and quality standards.
We work with models for 24, 26, and 29-inch rims, serving everyone from youth to adults on trails or in the city.

items.q: How does the lifetime warranty work?
items.a: The warranty covers any structural defect in the frame for the first owner. It is our promise of an eternal product.

items.q: Can the bike handle impacts and trails?
items.a: Yes. The polymer has a natural flexibility that absorbs impacts better than aluminum, making it excellent for urban use and light trails.

items.q: How do I place my order?
items.a: You can choose your model in our online catalog and finish the purchase via WhatsApp or directly through the website.
Yes, we ship our bicycles and frames to all Brazilian states with reinforced packaging.

items.q: Can I buy just the frame?
items.a: Yes, we sell the Muzzi Frame separately for those who wish to build their own component configuration.
Yes, we have already exported to several countries and hold patents in more than 140 nations.
